verdict.rationale: Steel publishes its browser API as open source in the steel-browser GitHub repo, with a pre-built Docker image combining the API and UI, so users can run the core product themselves. Its docs and site repeatedly position Steel as an open-source browser API, and a community commenter calls it an open-source Browserbase. Missing for 10: first-party self-hosting deployment docs in the pack, clarity on parity between self-hosted and managed cloud features (stealth, CAPTCHA solving, residential proxies, agent traces), and hands-on reports of running it self-hosted.
